search_text: published ZDI-16-441 ZDI-CAN-3588 Oracle WebLogic JtaTransactionManager Deserialization of Untrusted Data Remote Code Execution Vulnerability 2016-07-21 CVE-2016-3586 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2016-3586 7.5 ['Oracle'] ['WebLogic'] This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on vulnerable installations of Oracle WebLogic. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the use of JtaTransactionManager. It is possible to execute arbitrary commands upon deserialization. The attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the process. ['2016-04-13 - Vulnerability reported to vendor', '2016-07-21 - Coordinated public release of advisory'] Alvaro Munoz (@pwntester) & Christian Schneider (@cschneider4711) https://www.zerodayinitiative.com/advisories/ZDI-16-441/
title: Oracle WebLogic JtaTransactionManager Deserialization of Untrusted Data Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on vulnerable installations of Oracle WebLogic. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the use of JtaTransactionManager. It is possible to execute arbitrary commands upon deserialization. The attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the process.
